rows.note: It is the all-purpose choice for saying you have no preference or that something does not matter.

example.english: I’m indifferent about which restaurant we eat at.
example.traditional: 食邊間餐廳我都冇所謂。
example.jyutping: sik6 bin1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ngo5 dou1 mou5 so2 wai6

rows.note: Use this for a person who does not care or is unconcerned, rather than merely having no preference.

example.english: I’m indifferent to what he thinks of me.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zoi6 fu4 keoi5 dim2 tai2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when indifferent describes quality as only so-so or mediocre, not a person's attitude.

example.english: This movie was indifferent at best.
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 maa4 maa2 dei2
